items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He made a lot of records with Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: orchestra, he comes backstage... Not backstage, what am I talking about. We meet down at the station, because we're doing one-nighters, and we were going from station to station, from town to town. And we all meet at the station. And he's sitting up there in the car with Cootie, and they are talking about... This fellow, the leader, wanted to know where Cootie found this piano player. He said, "Do you know, that man is a genius! The way he plays and what he's playing?" Do you know what I mean? And this leader, he…

And boy, he could play, and be just as high... I don't know. But a schoolkid, I mean... What you say? Success come to him too quick. And just like Charlie Parker, I mean, one of them things, you know... He made a lot of records with Charlie Parker. He could really play.

But that's the type of band Cootie had, and he had a lot of good piano players come in that band. In fact, all the piano he ever had was outstanding. Good piano players. Of course, he had good musicians all through the band at some time or other. But they were comin' in and goin' out, changing the piano. And Cootie was just as nice as he could be to them.
